definition.name: compressed-product-display
definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex (tex:1077-1083, display compr_prod, definitional): For any triple (P,Q,R) of delta-projections, the compressed product (X,Y) -> X\cdot Y: S_{P,Q} x S_{Q,R} -> S_{P,R}, X\cdot Y = Co_{P,R}(XY). Adjacent definitional sentence: it is close to the ambient product, ||X\cdot Y - XY|| <= O(delta+eps)||X|| ||Y||; if P is nonvanishing the compressed product turns S_P (closed under involution) into an O(delta+eps)-C*-algebra with unit wtP = Co_P(P).
